rows.39:daa4:
"I've been so lonely, all this time.
I was all alone until you spoke to me that time.
I was even starting to forget my own name. But it's all right now.
I'm not lonely anymore.
Because now I have so many friends."
{f:What on earth|What on earth}...
A rope was wound tightly around {f:my|my} neck.
Not just {f:mine|mine}: every member in this room had a rope around their neck, and the other ends were gripped in Fukuzawa's hand.
Everyone was struggling desperately, but the ropes only dug in deeper...
My consciousness was slowly slipping away.
I couldn't feel my arms and legs anymore.
"I'm not lonely anymore."
Only Fukuzawa's voice was bright and bouncing.
The students who vanished from the club room...
{f:We|We} were going to become one of this school's seven wonders too............{p}
rows.39:f5c4:
You'd set them free?
That's pretty cool-headed of you.
Yeah, living your whole life thinking only of someone who's dead is kind of sad, isn't it?
Precisely because they're precious to you, you want them to enjoy life for both of you, right?
Tying them to yourself when you don't belong in this world anymore is just selfishness, I think.
Well, I'm sure some people think that's love, and that's their call.
Ishikawa's a good example of that, isn't she?
'I've had the one love of my lifetime.
Ogura is my one and only eternal love...'
Only a truly pure person or a narcissist could think like that.
She's the self-infatuated type, isn't she?
Maybe all those incidents were really Ishikawa's own doing, and she'd just convinced herself it was Ogura's ghost...{p}
